title: edikt post-flight composite report
description: Composite report emitted by the post-flight-synthesizer. Wraps L1 (criteria verify), L2 (governance verifier), and L3 (specialist) outputs into one deduplicated machine-readable artifact. Persisted to .edikt/state/post-flight/<plan>-<phase>-<ts>.json by commands/sdlc/post-flight.md. Consumed by the plan harness (row-flip gate), doctor, and any future CI surface.

plan.description: Plan slug (basename of PLAN-<slug>.md without extension).

phase.description: Phase number from the plan progress table.

synthesizer_version.description: Version stamp of the post-flight-synthesizer agent template that produced this report.

dispatch_mode.description: How the orchestrator was invoked. auto-hook = phase-end-detector.sh; manual = user-typed /edikt:sdlc:post-flight; stub = EDIKT_POSTFLIGHT_STUB=1 (e2e tests only).

findings.description: Deduplicated findings from L2 (per-directive FAIL/NEEDS_REVIEW) and L3 (specialist critical/warning/info). May be empty. L1 verdicts are summarized in l1_summary, not in findings.

line_range.description: Line span in the diff the finding cites, e.g. '42-58' or '42'.

issue_class.description: Short label categorizing the finding (e.g. 'INV-NNN', 'OWASP-A03', 'security', 'no-hardcoded-secret'). Synthesizer must never invent or normalize this value — preserve the source agent's token verbatim.

sources.description: Origins of the finding as <layer>:<issue_class> strings. When two source findings dedupe to one merged finding, this array lists all origins (e.g. ['l2:INV-NNN', 'l3:security']).

description.description: Plain-text description. Markdown code fences are rejected — agent text must never carry shell content into downstream channels (no-agent-text-into-shell hardening).

severity.description: Maximum severity across merged sources. critical > warning > info. L2 FAILs default to warning unless an L3 critical covered the same tuple.

status.description: Layer-level outcome. passed = clean; failed = at least one fail; skipped = layer intentionally not run; partial = layer ran but some sub-jobs failed (e.g. L3 specialist timeout); unavailable = layer attempted but could not run (claude -p spawn failure, malformed input).

counts.description: Per-status counters specific to the layer. L1 has pass/fail/blocked/skipped; L2 has pass/fail/needs_review/skipped; L3 has critical/warning/info/skipped. All fields optional; absence implies 0.

reason.description: Optional explanation for skipped / partial / unavailable. Empty for passed / failed.
